config.worktreeCacheDirectory.descriptio: Custom parent directory for PR worktrees. Leave empty to use the default extension storage location.
config.notificationPollingEnabled.descri: Periodically poll Forgejo instances for unread notifications and show VS Code alerts.
config.notificationPollingInterval.descr: Interval in seconds between notification polls.
config.useMockApi.description: Use mock Forgejo API responses for offline development. Development use only; stripped from production builds.
config.mcpEnabled.description: Expose the configured Forgejo instances to agent mode as read-only MCP servers. Turning this off withdraws the server definitions immediately and stops the workspace-repository mapping and the local broker; a client that is already connected keeps the server process it spawned until the window is reloaded.

capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: Forgejo Toolkit reads and caches repository state (git worktrees, the extension's cache directory and instance configuration), so it is disabled in Restricted Mode until you trust the workspace.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces.descripti: Forgejo Toolkit needs real files: it creates git worktrees and maintains a local cache directory for repositories and pull requests.
